newsitem.title: USA: Tejon Ranch says Times sells stake.
newsitem.headline: Tejon Ranch says Times sells stake.

text.p: Tejon Ranch Co said Friday that its largest shareholder, Times Mirror Co, has agreed to sell its remaining 30 percent stake in the company to two New York-based investment funds: Third Avenue Trust and Carl Marks Management Co.
Tejon did not disclose terms, but said the price reflected a discount from the market's trading price.
Tejon shares closed Friday unchanged at 18-7/8.
"We are pleased that we have been able to achieve our investment objective in a transaction that is consistent with the objective of Tejon Ranch's management," a company statement said.

Tejon Ranch owns a ranch of about 270,000 acres 60 miles north of downtown Los Angeles. The company is also involved in commercial real estate, farming, ranching, recreation, filming and mineral extraction.
